title: Multi-NIC (v1.20+): a later rollback needs multi-homed pods removed and nodes recycled first

detection.reason: ENABLE_MULTI_NIC's VALUE is not collected; multi-homed pods carry the k8s.amazonaws.com/nicConfig annotation

quote: If the feature is enabled and you plan to downgrade the plugin from v1.20.0+, ensure that all multi-homed pods are removed first to prevent IP leaks and then set the `ENABLE_MULTI_NIC` to `false`.
remediation: If you enable ENABLE_MULTI_NIC after this upgrade, a rollback below v1.20 must first delete every pod annotated k8s.amazonaws.com/nicConfig: multi-nic-attachment, then set ENABLE_MULTI_NIC=false, then drain and replace the nodes to release the ENIs on network cards above index 0 — otherwise IPs and ENIs leak.
verifyCommand: kubectl get pods -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.annotations["k8s.amazonaws.com/nicConfig"] != null) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each pod printed is multi-homed and must be removed before a rollback below v1.20
